title.zh: 所得税（外国收入豁免）（第 9 号）命令 2005
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 9) Order 2005

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 9) Order 2005.

2. Lenovo (Singapore) Pte Ltd is hereby granted exemption from tax on the foreign dividends received in Singapore from Hong Kong from 1st May 2005 to 30th April 2010 (both dates inclusive), subject to the conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 28th April 2005 addressed to the Economic Development Board.
